venue.address: Address will be emailed to registered competitors

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0ZyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0f79de34f74b7a5f43eff3c7dcaa5f0965315de/hilliardhippocampuswebsite.png) This competition is on a **Monday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. To celebrate National Chocolate Day, chocolate will be given as prizes.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den tredje deltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Mer information om Uppsalaligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the third competition in the autumn season of Uppsalaligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.
